tournament_name: Ice Box Flip Frenzy Group Knockout challenge
details:
Welcome to a new pinball adventure with our latest format, the Flip Frenzy Group Knockout challenge!

This will be a max value event, scheduled to hit 200% TGP.

Registration starts at 1PM.
The tournament will start at 1:30PM sharp.
There is a LIMIT of 64 players total and the registration is $10 each.
The Ice Box is sponsoring the IFPA fee so 100% of the registration is paid back to the top 50% of the finalists.

The qualifying will be a Flip Frenzy format on NEW and OLD games for 3.5 hours, from 1:30 PM to 5:00PM.
After 5:00 PM the top 50% ranked players will move onto the finals. If there are any tie breakers for the top 16 spot, a full game on a OLD machine will be played.
 
The finals will be for the top 50% of the players to move on to a Progressive Group Strike finals. The number of Strike will be based on how many players makes finals to get the remaining XX meaningful games to get to 50.
It will be 2 rounds of classic machines followed by one round of modern, so on until one player is left.

Seattle Pinball Services’ monthly Max Value events have become so popular that they frequently sell out! Here's some clarified rules on our sign up process:

We do not do pre-registration, UNLESS you are traveling more than 50 miles. If you are traveling and want to play, contact Germain on Facebook.
You must be present at the venue to sign up.
If you forfeit your spot, the entry will go to the next person on the waitlist.

Sometimes we have almost enough players in line at the time sign ups open to fill our capacity, so make sure you plan accordingly!

This tournament will follow official IFPA rules, https://www.ifpapinball.com/rules/
